simple.meaning: בֵּין (bêyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “among, between.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֵּין (H997) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 7:5, with occurrences in Daniel.

occurrences.englishText: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!’

“I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots: and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.
